description: Verify a PowerQuant deliverable by sha256: signature, issue date, reviewer and whether a regulatory change since issue affects it. Input: the 64-hex sha256 from the document footer or the powerquant.dk/verify/<sha> link. Read-only, no personal data; unknown hash returns found:false. (Verificér en PowerQuant-leverance på sha256: signatur, udstedelsesdato, reviewer og om en regelændring siden udstedelsen påvirker den.)

sha.description: sha256 of the deliverable — 64 hex characters, from the document footer or the /verify/<sha> link

name: verify_deliverable
